name: Flow canvas — freshly created flow 'PARA research scratch' (generation lifecycle probe)

primaryActions.label: bottom composer (Chat · GPT 4.1 inherited from home) + Send

evidence.note: first send from /blank created an empty flow

observations.text: Submitting the home composer navigated to a new /conv/<uuid> ('Untitled Flow', 94% zoom) containing only the invisible root node; the first prompt did not land (the earlier type call had not verified). The flow object nonetheless existed and appeared in History.

Sending from the in-flow composer immediately created two nodes: the prompt node ('Me · Just now') and an empty answer placeholder node (job submitted). ~6 s later the placeholder rendered an in-node card 'Need a refill? You've utilized all your credits, upgrade to keep your workflow moving. 0 Credits [View pricing]'.
The flow title changed from 'Untitled Flow' to the first prompt text automatically.
After reload the prompt node and the failed placeholder node were still present (job outcome is persisted as a node). The failed node's toolbar offers Delete only — no Rerun/Retry.
The in-flow composer opened in Chat · GPT 4.1 (last-used home mode); the tutorial flow's composer opened in Neo Agent — the mode follows the flow's last use (I2).

Job lifecycle as observed: submitted -> placeholder node (running) -> terminal state rendered in-node (here failed/credit-blocked). Successful text runs presumably stream into the same node (tutorial answer nodes are the completed form).
Whether a running job survives navigation away (could not run a real job with 0 credits); whether the user can keep editing while a run streams; cancel affordance.
